juego.retroceder_ayuda: Rewind (each tap: x2, x4, x8, x16; ← key one line)
juego.adelantar_ayuda: Fast-forward to the next choice (each tap: x2, x4, x8, x16)
juego.ocultar_ayuda: Hide the text box to see the picture (H key)
juego.girar_nota: PROJECT GENESIS is played in landscape.
juego.volver_titulo: Click to return to the title screen
salir.texto: You'll lose any progress you haven't saved. There's no autosave here: this isn't the office cloud.
salir.texto_fin: If you leave without saving, you'll have to replay this whole chapter to reach the next one. Like a Monday, only longer.
guardar.reemplaza: This replaces the save that was here.
guardar.borrar_texto: “{nombre}” will be gone for good. There’s no trash bin: this isn’t your inbox.
finales.proximos: The story's endings will arrive with the next chapters.
opciones.preview: This is how the text will look. I swear on my apron.
opciones.auto: Auto mode: pause after each line, {n} s
opciones.ocultar_tip: To see the picture without the text box: the «Hide» button or the H key. Any click brings it back.
opciones.tecleo: Sound while the text is typed
opciones.reducir: Reduce effects (turns off glitches and interface effects)
mapa.ayuda: Drag to move · wheel or pinch to zoom
secreto.aviso: You've seen it all… almost. Replay Chapter 2: at the hot springs, Rikka changes behind a rock.
extras.galeria_desc: The pictures and characters you've unlocked.
extras.finales_desc: The endings and bad ends you found.
progreso.falta: You're {n}% away from 100%: {k} things left to find.
progreso.completo: 100%. You found everything. Now go touch some grass.
opciones.borrar_seguro: This can't be undone. No trash bin, no backup, and GENESIS won't autocomplete anything you lose.
opciones.borrar_desc: Saves, gallery, endings, Boringram, read text and options. Everything. As if you'd never played.
opciones.borrar_frase: i accept losing everything, just like my paycheck
opciones.borrar_nota: Capital letters are optional. Resignation is not.
nivel.aviso: If you lose, it's a bad ending: the story ends here.
nivel.jair: Jair: punches. Strong, very short range.
nivel.cami: Cami: blaster. Short range; if she fires too much it runs out and you have to wait for it to recharge.
batalla.distraido: {quien} is still thinking about what they heard. No attack.
batalla.especial_no: The special is not charged yet ({n}%).
secreto.aviso_cap01: Something new at the bar. Replay Chapter 1: when Nikki asks for a kiss, you will have another option. It is not a good one.
batalla.desc.atacar: Pick one of your attacks and a target. It can miss: sometimes the enemy dodges.
batalla.desc.hablar: Say something to the enemy. Sometimes they get distracted and lose their next attack (not the boss).
batalla.desc.esquivar: This turn you get ready to dodge: each hit thrown at you can miss ({p} % of the time).
batalla.desc.objetos: Use something from the backpack on yourself or an ally.
batalla.desc.huir_no: There is no running from this fight.
batalla.desc.especial_carga: Special bar: {n} %. It fills by attacking, taking hits, talking or dodging.
batalla.desc.obj_atq: Attack +{n} until the end of the fight.
batalla.desc.obj_def: Defense +{n} until the end of the fight.
batalla.desc.obj_carga: Fills the special bar at once.
batalla.desc.obj_niveles: Raises {n} levels at once. Tastes awful.
batalla.desc.obj_revive: Revives a fallen ally with {n} % of their HP.
batalla.clon_aparece: {quien} gives part of their life to their shadow: the clone lasts {n} turns.
batalla.clon_no_escucha: {quien} does not listen. It is just a shadow.
batalla.confundido: {quien} is head over heels: {n} turns of not quite knowing who to hit.
batalla.se_golpea: {quien} is so confused they hit themselves.
batalla.cebo_aparece: The copy does nothing. It just stands there. With luck, someone hits it instead.
batalla.cebo_cae: {quien} (the decoy) falls apart at the first hit. It did its only job.
batalla.desc.cebo: Leaves a black-and-white copy of yourself. It does nothing: sometimes the enemy hits it instead of you, and it falls apart at the first hit. The most useless move there is, except for sneaking out of work if your boss does not notice.
